editorial:
When your best friend is gunned down in a coffee shop and the police brush it off as gang violence, you might just decide to take matters into your own hands. That's exactly what Addison does in this moody teen thriller, teaming up with his sharp, supportive girlfriend Phoebe to dig into Kevin's murder. The story mixes high school drama with a gritty investigation, giving you a tense, personal mystery that feels grounded in real emotions rather than big action set pieces.

The performances carry the film, especially the chemistry between the two leads, who make you care about their relationship even when the plot gets messy. The pacing is steady and the atmosphere is dark, though some twists feel rushed and the ending may leave you wanting more. If you enjoy slow-burn mysteries with young characters and a serious tone, this one is worth a look. Stream it in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video, rent it on Apple TV, or grab the 4K Blu-ray for your collection.
endingExplained: In the final act, Addison discovers Kevin was killed because of a drug deal gone wrong involving a local dealer, not random gang violence. The truth hits hard when Addison confronts the killer and realizes the system failed his friend. Phoebe stands by him as he accepts that justice won't come easy. The movie closes on a bittersweet note, with Addison changed forever and the case leaving more questions than answers.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves teen mysteries with a gritty edge.
